name: Hasegawa Shiori
source:
Shiori was [url=/c10801]Hisako[/url]'s kouhai at Seio Girls' Academy in her school days. She was good at the piano and was a scholarship student of the music class at the school. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
